associations.rationale: This only defines the Jucys-Murphy element and states no eigenvalue property.
Its second conjunct directly states that every eigenvalue is the cast of an integer, while also proving diagonalizability and bounds.
This algebraic identity expresses the Jucys-Murphy element as a difference of transposition sums but does not state eigenvalue integrality.
The formal type directly states that any eigenvalue of the Jucys-Murphy action on a finite-dimensional representation equals an integer cast.
